deviations: One operation selected first, as the card asks: scene-cut detection (`yamakan.analysis.sceneCuts`, scope render:execute). Denoise and stabilize were source-inspected in the bundled FFmpeg 7.1.1 filter list but not implemented
Analysis only: it reads the stored original in a bounded worker and writes nothing, so source, PTS and audio are preserved by construction
Times are exact: the stream is retimed to flicks (settb=1/705600000) and the integer pts is parsed, never FFmpeg's rounded pts_time; frames by nearest rounding

One analysis at a time with at most two waiting (a fourth is BUSY); 300 s wall limit; a cancel before the start runs no worker and a mid-run cancel stops it (tested against the measured full scan time)

tests.result: 4/4: cuts found at the exact source frames of a synthetic edit, deterministic across runs and thresholds bounded; a damaged stream fails safely inside FFmpeg; early and mid-run cancels stop the worker; a burst of four gives exactly one BUSY
